top_signals.title: US 30-Year Yields Return to 2002 High With Crude Above $100
top_signals.summary: US Treasuries resumed their retreat, lifting the 30-year yield back to its highest since 2002 as climbing oil prices raised concern about faster inflation and more central bank interest-rate increases.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: SpaceX Credit Risk Gauge Hits Record High on Fundraising Reports
top_signals.summary: A measure of SpaceX’s credit risk surged to a fresh high and the company’s bonds tumbled in the secondary market on Wednesday, following reports the company is in talks with banks and investors to raise $40 billion to buy chips from Nvidia Corp.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Mexico Local Bond Sales Hit Record as Companies Rush to Market
top_signals.summary: Mexican companies are tapping the local bond market at a record clip as lower interest rates at home, looming maturities and a growing pool of institutional capital spur deals.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Spain Unions Crash Election Campaign, Calling a General Strike
top_signals.summary: Spain’s biggest labor unions are set to call a general strike for Nov. 11 to focus attention on housing just before campaigning begins for an election scheduled for Nov. 29.
